author: Arman Ossi Loko
name: AspNetDesktop app (React)
description: A desktop app with an in-process ASP.NET Core backend (no port) and a React UI, hosted in the system WebView.

manualInstructions.text: Debug with hot reload: run 'npm install' and 'npm start' in ClientApp (dev server on :5173), then 'dotnet run'. Release: 'dotnet run -c Release' builds the UI into wwwroot and serves it from app://.
